outputs.explanation: Panel A is a Western blot image, not a plot showing averaged data; individual data points are not applicable.
Bar charts (pFoxO3(Ser253)/FoxO3 and pFoxO3(Thr32)/FoxO3) show group means with error bars but no overlaid individual data points.
Bar chart of pAKT(Thr308)/AKT shows means with error bars only; no individual data points are plotted.
Panel D is a Western blot image, not a plot of averaged data.
Bar charts (pFoxO3(Ser253)/FoxO3 and pFoxO3(Thr32)/FoxO3 fold change) display means with error bars but lack individual data point overlays.
Bar chart of pAKT(Thr308)/AKT fold change shows means with error bars only, no individual data points shown.
Panel G is a Western blot image, not a plot of averaged data.
Bar charts (pFoxO3(Ser253)/FoxO3 and pFoxO3(Thr32)/FoxO3 fold change) show means with error bars but no individual data points overlaid.
Bar chart of pAKT(Thr308)/AKT fold change shows means with error bars only; individual data points are not displayed.
Panel J consists of immunocytochemistry micrographs (representative images), not a plot of averaged quantitative data.
